judged_text: findMembers changed its empty-name contract from resolving [] to returning undefined, and callers (both route setupController hooks) fire it without handling the promise. Any future caller that chains .then on findMembers (as the old routes did) gets a TypeError on the no-name path since the sentinel now means 'not loaded' rather than 'empty list' — the semantics change is unguarded by any caller update in this diff.
